_schema.file: runs/manual_trades.json (gitignored; copy this file there and edit). A missing file means no manual trades.
_schema.top_level: {"trades": [ ...one object per trade... ]}. The _schema key is ignored.
_schema.time_wib: required key; HH:MM or HH:MM:SS Jakarta time, or null when unknown
_schema.fee_idr: required, number >= 0 (decimals allowed, e.g. 6.5), total broker + exchange fee for this trade
_schema.net_amount_idr: optional, number: the broker's net amount (shown, not recomputed)
_schema.broker_realised_pnl_idr: optional, number: the broker's own realised profit/loss for this sell
_schema.closes_order_id: optional: order_id of a bot order this trade closes; must exist in the stores

trades.note: Example only: sold by hand in the broker app.
